source: DfT Aviation Statistics AVI0102b (air transport movements at full reporting airports by airport)
attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0
note: Annual air transport movements (landings + take-offs) per UK full reporting airport in 2024, from DfT table AVI0102b (published as thousands to 3 decimal places; multiplied by 1,000 and rounded to an exact count). Air transport movements only: excludes non-ATM activity such as general aviation, positioning, training and air-taxi operations, and excludes the Channel Islands and Isle of Man (not in AVI0102). Airports with no reported traffic in the year are omitted. Airport reference-point coordinates and codes are not in AVI0102: carried from the previous bundle or looked up in OurAirports (public domain). Regenerate each December with scripts/build_dft_avi0102.py.
